description: One-shot, anonymized, network-isolated historical shadow deployment.
selection_rule: Final five chronological fixtures with no zero-minute/DNP candidate after excluding snapshots lacking historical pregame availability data.
limitations: Researcher has previously viewed aggregate results from the broader 20-slate dataset.
Inputs are anonymized to prevent model recall or web lookup of historical outcomes.
Candidate universe still originates from same-day box-score roster rows.
No historical injury reports, betting lines, salaries, DraftKings bonuses, or real user roster.
Five slates provide directional evidence, not statistical significance or profitability evidence.
